title: Cardlytics: The Ad Platform with Purchasing Power - [Business Breakdowns, EP. 17]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Today, we will be diving into Cardlytics.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we will be diving into Cardlytics. Founded in 2008, Cardlytics operates as an advertising platform integrated with the digital channels of banks. It allows advertisers to identify potential customers from their spending habits and reach those customers directly within their mobile banking applications.

key_points.text: Today, Cardlytics is one of the largest digital ad platforms, seeing data on 50% of every card swipe in the US.
To help break down Cardlytics, I will be joined by Cliff Sosin, founder of CAS Investment Partners.
During our conversation, we touch on what makes Cardlytics' value proposition so valuable to the ecosystem, how Cardlytics' measurement capabilities differ from Google.
